description: This file defines an Express.js controller function for an API endpoint that retrieves and aggregates new user counts over time, supporting different granularities (day, week, month). It interacts with a MongoDB database to perform aggregation queries and exports the function for routing.

methods.name: newUsersOverTime
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to fetch aggregated new user counts over a specified time range and granularity, querying MongoDB and returning the results as JSON.
